skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to understand the nature of data and its basic characteristics.
Students will be able to classify data effectively.
Students will be able to use R software for data analysis programming.
Students will learn to create and set up a simple database using SQL Server.
Students will be able to preprocess data for analysis.
Students will be able to perform basic statistical analyses.
Students will be able to conduct advanced data analysis including machine learning methods and financial data analysis.
Students will be able to visualize data using R.
Students will develop independent work skills through the course.
Students will develop collaborative work skills through the course.
Students will improve their presentation skills through the course.
